entries.name: Ice Barrier
entries.summary: You rapidly form a solid ice shield, wall, brace, bridge, or obstacle from moisture and cold. Use this to block attacks, create cover, seal a route, cross danger, or control movement until heat or force breaks it.

entries.name: Identify the Hidden Rule
entries.summary: Study an unfamiliar magical effect long enough to infer one governing rule, limitation, or repeated condition that can be tested. It reveals a workable principle, not the entire secret of the magic.

entries.name: Identity Split
entries.summary: Keep evidence, habits, allies, and timing from linking two identities together. Resists investigation that relies on ordinary social pattern matching.

entries.name: Identity Ward
entries.summary: You reinforce the spiritual identity of yourself or several willing allies against hostile supernatural alteration, displacement, and effects that threaten their sense of self.

entries.name: Immediate Riposte
entries.summary: You turn a narrow parry, sidestep, or avoided thrust into an immediate riposte before the opponent recovers. Enables a counterattack after a successful close defense.

entries.name: Impact Mantle
entries.summary: You maintain raw amplification through a short exchange, strengthening several related impacts or acts of exertion. The effect magnifies what you are already doing rather than creating independent force.

entries.name: Impossible Accord
entries.summary: You construct a compromise around the interests neither side can surrender and the concessions each can survive. Use this to break a major deadlock, preserve an alliance under severe strain, or turn open hostility into a workable settlement whose costs are explicit.

entries.name: Impossible Angle
entries.summary: Use terrain, elevation, wind, timing, and ricochet logic to make a shot others would reject. Can strike a target that is barely reachable if the scene gives any real line or indirect path.

entries.name: Impossible Ascent
entries.summary: You make an impossible ascent into a route, carrying rope, tools, and confidence behind you. Can open a path for the group through cliffs, towers, ruins, or storm-lashed rigging.

entries.name: Impossible Expedition Plan
entries.summary: You turn a dangerous expedition into a legendary operation of roles, supplies, routes, contingencies, hazard answers, and victory conditions. Use this to prepare a group for a world-class journey, ruin delve, monster hunt, sea voyage, or military-scale exploration.

entries.name: Impossible Helm
entries.summary: You make a legendary craft answer impossible conditions through nerve, timing, and total system awareness. Can survive or accomplish one maneuver that should be beyond the vehicle's normal limits.

entries.name: Impossible Labyrinth
entries.summary: You read a dungeon, ruin, vault, or impossible structure as a complete living system of danger, design, history, and hidden routes. Use this to reveal the true path, bypass legendary threats, locate secret chambers, or guide allies through a place meant to kill intruders.

entries.name: Impossible Machine
entries.summary: Design a daring mechanism that should barely work but answers the crisis exactly. Creates a one-use engineered solution to a major obstacle if the materials and time exist.

entries.name: Impossible Recovery
entries.summary: Turn a near fall, failed landing, sudden shove, or collapsing footing into a controlled recovery that preserves a useful position. It can salvage movement that would normally end badly without negating impossible physics.

entries.name: Impossible Route
entries.summary: You cross an impossible-looking route of ledges, beams, ropes, walls, and moving hazards as one continuous flow. Bypasses ordinary ground-based obstacles and pursuit.

entries.name: Impossible Scene
entries.summary: You sustain a large multi-sense fabrication that can replace the apparent shape, sound, and atmosphere of an entire encounter area. Contradictory evidence, touch, wards, or careful investigation can still break the deception.

entries.name: Impossible Whisper
entries.summary: You recover meaning from extraordinarily faint, distant, or partially masked sound when a physical acoustic path still exists, separating signal from noise with legendary precision.

entries.name: Improvised Rig
entries.summary: Assemble a temporary tool, brace, trigger, pulley, or mechanism from available parts. Creates a useful device for one immediate task.

entries.name: Inconsistent Report
entries.summary: Compare patrol accounts, witness statements, route claims, official explanations, and repeated retellings to catch contradictions between what people say. Reveals a useful inconsistency in the accounts; contradictions that depend primarily on written records belong to Archival Research.

entries.name: Index Jump
entries.summary: You use catalog structure, cross-references, clerical habits, and archive organization to move quickly from a broad question to the most promising record group.

entries.name: Inferno Column
entries.summary: You call or shape a pillar, wall, or rolling surge of sustained flame in a target area. Use this to block movement, scatter enemies, burn cover, punish clustered foes, or force a dangerous battlefield shift.

entries.name: Information Stake
entries.summary: You set a safe stake that buys information, access, or goodwill without risking ruin. Turns a game into a controlled social probe rather than simple chance.

entries.name: Ingredient Read
entries.summary: You identify obvious ingredients, spoilage, excessive salt, dilution, common herbs, or preparation mistakes from a careful taste.

entries.name: Inside Cut
entries.summary: You slip inside a larger guard and strike at straps, tendons, exposed wrists, or gaps rather than trading blows. Can disable grip, movement, or equipment when you reach close range.

entries.name: Inside the Guard
entries.summary: Slip a light blade through the space created by a committed guard, grapple, shield edge, or cramped exchange. It creates a close-range opening that heavier weapons usually cannot exploit.

entries.name: Institutional Override
entries.summary: You find the records, permissions, schedules, responsible offices, and procedural leverage needed to make one institution act during a crisis. Use this to cut through internal delay, assign a workable chain of responsibility, or mobilize resources that already fall within that institution’s authority.

entries.name: Interest Read
entries.summary: You read whether attraction, curiosity, admiration, hesitation, or pride is shaping a romantic exchange. Reveals a fitting approach without creating attraction or overriding boundaries.

entries.name: Interpose
entries.summary: Move a shield into the line of a dangerous attack aimed at a nearby ally and turn the impact into a defended exchange. It can protect someone you can physically reach without making either of you invulnerable.

entries.name: Intrusion Break
entries.summary: You strike at the bond between a hostile spiritual presence and its host, object, or location. It can force separation or create an opening for exorcism when the intruding presence is actually vulnerable.

entries.name: Inversion Zone
entries.summary: You tilt the direction of down across a defined area, making walls, ceiling, or a chosen vector become temporary falling directions. The zone affects friend and foe and can be extremely disorienting.

entries.name: Invisible Repair
entries.summary: Repair or alter a crafted object so the work preserves its intended appearance, balance, and ordinary function instead of leaving an obvious patch. It requires suitable tools and materials and cannot counterfeit provenance by itself.

entries.name: Invite the Answer
entries.summary: Create a controlled opening for a present spirit or spiritual trace to communicate through signs, impressions, or limited exchange. It invites response without compelling truth, obedience, or a spirit that is not there.

entries.name: Inviting Spark
entries.summary: You create a moment of appealing attention through warmth, confidence, style, or playful timing. Opens a friendly or flirtatious conversation, but never overrides consent or firm hostility.

entries.name: Iron Cathedral
entries.summary: You reshape a large mass of available metal into a fortress-like structure, layered defense, bridge, cage, or battlefield geometry. Scale and existing material matter, and enchanted metal can resist control.

entries.name: Iron Command
entries.summary: You command nearby metal in a decisive scene, making blades twist, armor lock, chains move, gates strain, or metal debris become a weapon or shield. Relics, masterwork enchantments, and massive structures resist direct control.

entries.name: Iron Discipline
entries.summary: Force frightened soldiers, workers, subordinates, or allies back into formation through command presence, example, threat, or hard-earned authority. Forces a frightened or unstable group back into formation or obedience.

entries.name: Iron Orbit
entries.summary: You hold several metal objects in controlled magnetic orbit around yourself or a point. They can form moving cover, tools, or projectile threats, but nonmetal material is unaffected.

entries.name: Iron Shape
entries.summary: You bend, reinforce, soften, sharpen, or warp a limited amount of metal through focused resonance. Use this to repair a weapon, weaken a lock, strengthen armor seams, bend bars, reshape a tool, or make metal briefly answer your intent.

entries.name: Ironbody Resolve
entries.summary: You endure legendary punishment of poison, exhaustion, exposure, pain, or deprivation with terrifying control. Can remain functional through a crisis that would drop almost anyone else.

entries.name: Ironhide Harness
entries.summary: You reinforce leather gear at its stress points until it can endure harsh travel or combat. Use this to strengthen boots, straps, packs, armor pieces, saddles, harnesses, or protective gear for one major scene.

entries.name: Ivory Colossus
entries.summary: You assemble fossil material, carved bone, or another prepared skeletal framework into a temporary moving structure, guardian, bridge, or siege shape. Its size and durability depend on the material available. The construction is animated structure rather than a restored creature or captured soul.

entries.name: Joint Lock
entries.summary: Catch wrist, elbow, shoulder, or stance at the wrong angle and turn strength against itself. Can restrain or disarm a humanoid opponent on a successful close contest.

entries.name: Keep Moving
entries.summary: You force your body to keep functioning while poisoned, feverish, starving, hungover, or sleep-starved. Lets you complete one necessary scene before the condition fully claims you.

entries.name: Key's Turn
entries.summary: You awaken the Key within the Luporian medallion while touching a mundane lock, latch, fastening, or keyed mechanism. For this action, the medallion reshapes its magic to function as the missing physical key or fitting, allowing you to attempt to open or operate the mechanism without possessing the correct key or tools. It cannot automatically overcome a jammed, trapped, broken, magically sealed, or deliberately keyless mechanism, and success is not guaranteed where the mechanism itself resists operation.

entries.name: Killing Flicker
entries.summary: Hide the true weapon, target, or release point until the last instant. Bypasses ordinary guard with one precise thrown strike.

entries.name: Killing Lane
entries.summary: You control a lane with pre-aimed bolts, reload rhythm, and threat discipline. Enemies crossing the watched line risk interruption, forced cover, or being pinned before they can complete movement.

entries.name: Killing Rhythm
entries.summary: Read the rhythm of a melee and choose the instant when strength, reach, and footwork align. Greatly improves one decisive weapon exchange.

entries.name: Kind Face Read
entries.summary: You catch a small emotional truth beneath someone's words. Use this to sense fear, guilt, grief, hesitation, attraction, hidden kindness, or quiet hostility in a conversation.

entries.name: Kinetic Flow
entries.summary: You seize the rhythm of movement across a scene, redirecting momentum through bodies, weapons, debris, and terrain. Use this to turn enemy motion against them, accelerate allies, collapse a charge, or chain movement into a decisive shift.

entries.name: Kinetic Lance
entries.summary: You compress raw force into a narrow piercing impact against one target or point. It sacrifices area for exceptional direct pressure and can punch through weak barriers.

entries.name: Kingbane Venom
entries.summary: You shape an exceptionally potent single-target toxin keyed to a creature type, physiology, or known vulnerability. It remains resistible and dangerous to handle, but can threaten foes ordinary poison cannot affect.

entries.name: Kingbreaker Bolt
entries.summary: You make one prepared bolt decide a battlefield problem: sever a rope, drop a rider, interrupt a ritual hand, break a mechanism, or strike a legendary weak point. The shot creates a decisive tactical consequence beyond damage.

entries.name: Kingdom Heartbeat Drive
entries.summary: You sync courage, mana, and motion into a bright battle rhythm that carries allies forward. Use this to launch a team push, protect someone while attacking, turn defense into offense, or make a heroic action feel larger than one person.

entries.name: Kitchen Heartbeat
entries.summary: You keep heat, timing, portions, and morale moving together. Use this to prepare simple food, stretch supplies, prevent waste, or turn a rough meal into comfort.

entries.name: Knife-Storm Web
entries.summary: You become a storm of close angles, cutting straps, nerves, weapons, and escape routes before enemies understand the pattern. Can dismantle several nearby defenses without needing to kill every target.

entries.name: Knot of Reversal
entries.summary: Tie one looming consequence to a different plausible condition before it resolves, so the pattern can turn if that condition is fulfilled. The Wyrd must have a real narrative connection between the events; this cannot freely rewrite fate or erase consequences already completed.

entries.name: Labyrinth Read
entries.summary: You read a dungeon, ruin, vault, or sealed structure as a designed killing field rather than a series of rooms. Use this to identify the safest route, predict hidden chambers, avoid layered threats, or guide allies through complex interior danger.

entries.name: Lancing Flame
entries.summary: You compress fire into a narrow sustained line meant to burn through one defended point. It can pierce cover, cut a hot channel, or concentrate on a major target rather than spreading across the scene.

entries.name: Land's Provision
entries.summary: You read an entire landscape as a supply system, identifying seasonal water, forage, medicines, fuel, shelter material, and renewable sources well enough to sustain a large traveling group over an extended route. The land must genuinely contain enough resources to support the plan.

entries.name: Lantern's Trace
entries.summary: You awaken the Lantern within the Luporian medallion while deliberately examining a nearby person, object, or small area. The medallion draws your attention to one relevant physical trace, concealed detail, disturbance, or inconsistency that is genuinely present but could otherwise be overlooked, allowing you to notice it without revealing what caused it or what it means. It cannot create evidence, reveal thoughts or intentions, reconstruct past events, or answer a question when no relevant observable trace exists.

entries.name: Last Line
entries.summary: Hold a threatened line long enough for allies to retreat, recover, or finish a critical action. Prevents ordinary pressure from collapsing the defended position unless the opposition decisively overcomes you.

entries.name: Last Reserve
entries.summary: You survive a dose, climate, wound stress, or deprivation that should incapacitate you, buying time for cure, shelter, or escape. Does not remove the harm, but keeps you standing.

entries.name: Last Stand
entries.summary: You keep functioning when isolation, injury, overwhelming odds, or terrifying presence should make surrender feel inevitable. Use this to hold a critical position or complete one necessary action without becoming fearless or invulnerable.

entries.name: Last-Breath Intervention
entries.summary: You enter a legendary healing focus where wounds, poison, shock, pulse, breath, and panic become solvable patterns. Use this to keep someone alive through impossible injury, stabilize multiple victims, or pull a patient back from the edge of death.

entries.name: Last-Light Miracle
entries.summary: You ignite a wide heroic force when a group is facing overwhelming danger, allowing allies to keep acting through fear, shock, and exhaustion for a decisive scene. It does not erase wounds or consequences afterward.

entries.name: Law of the Mark
entries.summary: You establish a powerful long-lived enchantment with explicit conditions, permissions, and failure clauses. It can govern a major object, chamber, threshold, warding system, or other prepared magical structure, but preparation and exact wording determine what the magic actually enforces.

entries.name: Law of the Room
entries.summary: Make your command of status, manners, and social consequence feel like law inside a formal gathering. Forces even hostile elites to answer within the frame you set.

entries.name: Lawblade Clause
entries.summary: You use law, custom, contract, or precedent as a weapon sharp enough to change the scene. Use this to halt an abuse of authority, expose a loophole, force negotiation, or protect someone through legal obligation.

entries.name: Layered Cover Story
entries.summary: You build a false account from real details, plausible chronology, supporting habits, and prepared answers so it survives sustained questioning. It remains vulnerable to hard contradictory evidence or facts you could not have anticipated.

entries.name: Layered Ward
entries.summary: Build a compact ward around one person, object, opening, or working space that is tuned against a specific incoming supernatural pressure. It can blunt or redirect that threat without becoming universal invulnerability.

entries.name: Leaping Strike
entries.summary: You convert a jump into a strike, grab, vault, or escape angle instead of merely crossing distance. Lets vertical movement create an immediate tactical opening.

entries.name: Legacy Before Pride
entries.summary: You set aside personal offense long enough to protect the future of a house, bloodline, institution, or long-term plan. Use this to restrain a reckless noble, choose the practical concession, preserve reputation under pressure, or turn humiliation into strategic patience.

entries.name: Legal Argument
entries.summary: Cite legal precedent, rights, or contractual obligations to gain advantage in a dispute, negotiation, or encounter with authority. Can halt or complicate actions taken against you or an ally.

entries.name: Legend in the Streets
entries.summary: Turn repeated appearances, symbols, rumors, and rescues into a living urban legend. Makes the persona influence a whole district scene even before direct action begins.

entries.name: Legend-Reforging
entries.summary: You reconstruct a ruined masterwork from warped pieces, broken joins, surviving material, and knowledge of its original design, preserving as much of the maker’s intended function as the remains allow. It cannot recreate missing relic magic or irreplaceable material from nothing.

entries.name: Leverage Pivot
entries.summary: You reshape a negotiation around what the other side cannot afford to lose. Use this to win concessions, turn refusal into a counteroffer, split hostile interests, or make your proposal feel inevitable.

entries.name: Leverage Trade
entries.summary: Turn a concession, supply shortage, or rival interest into bargaining pressure without open threat. Forces the other side to answer the practical value of your position.

entries.name: Life-Crown Restoration
entries.summary: You guide healing into the deeper rhythm of life itself. Use this to restore severe wounds, purge a lingering harmful condition, recover lost function, or keep someone alive through an otherwise fatal crisis.

entries.name: Life-Saving Hands
entries.summary: You turn panic into triage, choosing the exact action that keeps someone alive. Use this to stabilize severe wounds, manage shock, treat poison symptoms, or keep a dying person from slipping away.

entries.name: Life-Saving Intervention
entries.summary: Perform a desperate high-skill intervention at the edge of death using breath, pressure, medicine, or crisis judgment. Can pull a dying person back from immediate death if the injury is not beyond worldly treatment.

entries.name: Lift Surge
entries.summary: You set your feet, lock your breath, and commit your whole body to one heavy effort. Use this to lift, drag, shove, carry, force open, or brace against something physically demanding.

entries.name: Lightglow
entries.summary: You shape light into a controlled glow, glint, color, beam, or flare. Use this to illuminate darkness, mark a target, reveal reflective traces, signal across distance, dazzle briefly, or make hidden details easier to see.

entries.name: Lightning Jolt
entries.summary: You discharge an electrical pulse through air, metal, water, or touch. Use this to stun briefly, burn nerves, interrupt a fragile action, ignite conductive hazards, or punish lightly armored targets.

entries.name: Limb Lock
entries.summary: You dominate the body line of a dangerous foe through leverage, pain compliance, and brutal timing. Can shut down one limb, weapon arm, or escape route when close contact is established.

entries.name: Limitbreak Engine
entries.summary: You drive one chosen act of strength, movement, defense, or spell impact far beyond normal magical reinforcement. The effect is focused and immense, but backlash, exhaustion, and the original action limits still matter.

entries.name: Lineage Caution
entries.summary: Recognize when lineage, inheritance, adoption, legitimacy, or family-record matters are more dangerous than the public record suggests. Reveals when inheritance, adoption, legitimacy, or family records carry hidden danger.

entries.name: Linebreaker
entries.summary: You turn every swing into battlefield demolition, breaking shields, hafts, gates, armor posture, and courage. Can collapse a defended line if you reach the point holding it together.

entries.name: Little Lie Rhythm
entries.summary: You keep your voice, face, and timing steady through a controlled lie or omission. Use this to redirect a simple question, hide nerves, protect a secret, or maintain a false impression.

entries.name: Live Corridor
entries.summary: Guide allies through a trapped space by calling steps, pauses, and safe positions. Lets a group cross a known hazard with reduced risk.

entries.name: Living Alias
entries.summary: You inhabit a false identity so completely that records, witnesses, habits, and etiquette seem to agree. Can survive deep social scrutiny unless hard evidence or magic exposes the truth.

entries.name: Living Archive
entries.summary: Recall and organize vast learned material quickly enough to answer a crisis in motion. Produces the most relevant known fact, precedent, or warning when delay would matter.

entries.name: Living Armor
entries.summary: You make worn metal flex and redistribute itself around impacts, gaps, and movement. It can reinforce several defended angles at once but depends on having suitable metal already present.

entries.name: Living Barrier
entries.summary: You grow or shape plants and living wood into a barrier, bridge, shelter, brace, or shield. Use this to defend, climb, seal a path, reinforce terrain, or protect allies where growth can take root.

entries.name: Living Cover Story
entries.summary: You adapt an established deception while new questions, witnesses, or evidence appear, changing secondary details without breaking the central identity or chronology. Use this to survive an investigation that is actively testing the story rather than merely hearing it.

entries.name: Living Echoes
entries.summary: You command the lingering impressions of a place for one major scene, making old voices speak, past violence repeat symbolically, spell residue flare, or emotional memory become visible. Echoes are not perfect history.

entries.name: Living Layout
entries.summary: You create a document whose visual order makes complex information immediately usable: maps, witness tables, ritual notes, genealogies, or coded ledgers. Turns confusing records into actionable structure.

entries.name: Living Loom
entries.summary: You reshape a large quantity of available fiber into complex moving structures such as layered barriers, nets, bridges of cordage, restraints, suspended paths, reinforced sails, or shifting battlefield geometry. You may weave, unravel, tension, and redirect the material rapidly, but cannot create fiber that is not present.

entries.name: Living Mana Core
entries.summary: Your mana rises into a dominant, stable pressure that shapes the magical exchange around you. Use this to overpower resistance, stabilize impossible casting, resist suppression, or command a major contest of magic.

entries.name: Living Masquerade
entries.summary: Maintain an adaptive illusion around one person, creature, or object that adjusts small details of appearance, sound, and movement as the scene changes. It can survive casual interaction better than a static disguise, but touch, contradiction, wards, and close scrutiny can expose it.

entries.name: Living Rumor Network
entries.summary: You model several rumor streams across courts, markets, households, factions, and hidden networks at once, predicting how messages will mutate and where competing stories will collide. Use this to orchestrate a large information campaign whose outcome still depends on credibility and local interests.

entries.name: Living Scaffold
entries.summary: Drive nearby wood and viable plant growth into a temporary load-bearing structure such as a bridge, platform, brace, ladder, shelter, or elevated path. The result follows available material and living structure rather than becoming impossible architecture.

entries.name: Living Shade
entries.summary: Make your shadow act as a false tell, lure, or momentary distraction while you move elsewhere. Creates a strong misdirection against ordinary senses.

entries.name: Living Temper
entries.summary: Combine metal shaping magic with forging judgement to bend, reinforce, or correct an existing metal piece in the field without treating raw ore as a finished weapon. The effect remains limited by mass, quality, and access.

entries.name: Living Theorem
entries.summary: Solve a magical crisis in motion by turning theory into action without waiting for perfect conditions. Enables one extraordinary arcane intervention if the scene gives enough clues and materials.

entries.name: Living Thread
entries.summary: You manipulate a small amount of nearby thread, cloth, rope, or similar fiber, making it pull, curl, knot, loosen, stitch, wrap, or move with deliberate precision. The material must already exist and remains limited by its own strength and quantity.

entries.name: Living Trail Map
entries.summary: Read an entire local landscape as a living map of movement, fear, and habit. Determines the most likely route, hiding place, or interception point for a quarry in the region.

entries.name: Load Logic
entries.summary: Read stress, leverage, hinges, pulleys, and weak points in a structure or device. Reveals how to brace, break, move, or safely use it.

entries.name: Lock Whisper
entries.summary: You feel the first honest answer of a lock: cheap pins, stiff wards, false resistance, or a damaged catch. Reveals whether the lock can be opened quickly, needs tools, or hides danger.

entries.name: Lodestone Field
entries.summary: You create a localized field of attraction and repulsion around metal objects, armor, weapons, or magnetic terrain. Use this to disarm, pin, redirect projectiles, slow armored foes, pull debris into cover, or make a battlefield dangerous.

entries.name: Long Chase
entries.summary: You pace breath, stride, and pain so a chase becomes endurance rather than panic. Lets you keep pursuit or escape going after others would falter.

entries.name: Long Pull
entries.summary: You match current, crew timing, and hull weight to make a hard crossing without exhausting everyone. Improves group movement over water and reduces immediate fatigue.

entries.name: Loremaster Synthesis
entries.summary: Join history, language, ritual, politics, and geography into a single clear answer. Reveals a major context connection that ordinary research would miss.

entries.name: Lost Song Reconstruction
entries.summary: You rebuild an ancient or fragmented musical work from scattered motifs, damaged notation, oral variants, and cultural clues, revealing its likely intended form without inventing missing evidence.

entries.name: Lunar Change
entries.summary: You draw on moon-phase magic to alter instinct, body rhythm, tide, dream, or hidden nature for a short scene. Use this to strengthen night movement, awaken beastlike senses, reveal a concealed form, control a small tide, or expose transformation pressure.

entries.name: Magebreaker Pursuit
entries.summary: You move through hostile magic as though cutting through a storm, turning each step into pressure against the caster. Use this to close on a powerful mage, slip through spellfire, interrupt casting, or punish magical recovery.

entries.name: Magebreaker Waltz
entries.summary: You move through spell pressure with perfect timing, turning each dodge or step into a threat against the caster. Use this to close on a mage, slip through magical attacks, interrupt casting, or punish spell recovery.

entries.name: Magic Shield
entries.summary: You shape a personal barrier against force, spell impact, hostile weather, or incoming harm. Use this to reduce one attack, block a hazard, or protect someone close enough to cover.

entries.name: Magnetic Tug
entries.summary: You create a short pull or push between metal, lodestone, armor, weapons, or magnetic surfaces. Use this to tug a weapon off-line, pull a small metal item into hand, disturb armor balance, find hidden metal, or anchor yourself briefly.

entries.name: Make Them Volunteer
entries.summary: Steer a target toward supplying assumptions, details, or justifications that strengthen the story you want them to believe, reducing how much you must directly invent. Evidence and suspicion can still unravel the confidence.

entries.name: Make the Cost Visible
entries.summary: Demonstrate one credible consequence of continued resistance in a controlled way, sharpening pressure without immediately escalating to violence. The target may still refuse, flee, call help, or retaliate.

entries.name: Maker's Answer
entries.summary: You open a legendary lock as a conversation with its maker, understanding intent, trick, and weakness together. Can bypass an extraordinary mundane lock while leaving no obvious damage or forced-entry sign.

entries.name: Mana Burst Guard
entries.summary: You release a quick burst of mana through your body or focus to soften incoming force. Use this to resist magical pressure, reduce backlash, reinforce a guard, or survive a sudden spell impact.

entries.name: Mana Candle
entries.summary: You compress your mana into a small, steady inner flame before releasing it. Use this to stabilize a basic spell, prevent minor magical backlash, or carefully control a low-Power magical effect.

entries.name: Mana Command
entries.summary: Your mana rises into a controlled aura that stabilizes, empowers, and pressures everything around your next spell. Use this to overpower resistance, hold a difficult spell together, resist suppression, or dominate a magical exchange.

entries.name: Mana Pressure
entries.summary: You raise your mana into a visible crown of pressure that strengthens the next magical action. Use this to empower a spell, resist magical suppression, intimidate magically sensitive foes, or force unstable mana into obedience.

entries.name: Mana-Edged Wake
entries.summary: You drag mana behind a weapon or physical strike, leaving a short-lived arc of force. Use this to extend a melee attack's reach, strike a target just beyond normal range, or let a physical move carry magical pressure.

entries.name: Map the Real Allegiances
entries.summary: Separate formal hierarchy from practical loyalty in one faction scene, identifying who is likely to follow whom if pressure rises. It gives a political map, not hidden thoughts or guaranteed betrayal.

entries.name: Map the Unmapped
entries.summary: Produce a reliable working map from partial sightings, bearings, travel times, landmarks, and terrain logic, including the most likely shape of an unseen connection. Unknown ground remains an inference until explored.

entries.name: Maritime Law Recall
entries.summary: Cite river law, guest-right, harbor custom, salvage precedent, convoy rules, or port obligation to settle disputes or corner liars. Uses port custom, salvage precedent, or river law to settle disputes or corner liars.

entries.name: Marked Quarry
entries.summary: Mark one creature, group, or trail through tracks, scent, behavior, or visible signs. Maintains pursuit through ordinary terrain changes.

entries.name: Market Ear
entries.summary: You catch useful fragments from prices, complaints, rumors, and casual bargaining. Use this to gather minor information in markets, taverns, shops, docks, inns, or busy streets.

entries.name: Market Pressure
entries.summary: Use access to buyers, sellers, introductions, credit, route permission, or local cooperation to apply economic pressure without open confrontation. Applies economic leverage through access, introductions, credit, or route permission.

entries.name: Market Pressure Read
entries.summary: You judge how scarcity, season, transport risk, politics, fashion, and buyer urgency are changing the practical value of a good in the current market.

entries.name: Market Web
entries.summary: Use buyers, sellers, credit, favors, and transport to make one local market shift in your favor. Creates practical access or scarcity where social conditions allow it.

entries.name: Marketmaker's Turn
entries.summary: You combine scarcity, timing, leverage, supply, demand, and the interests of several traders into a deal that changes who controls the exchange. Use this to secure rare goods, expose manipulation, or redirect a major transaction without creating wealth from nothing.

entries.name: Marriage-Table Calculation
entries.summary: Evaluate alliances, dowries, courtship signals, family risks, inheritance concerns, and long-term consequences in marriage politics. Reveals alliance risks and political leverage in marriage or inheritance negotiations.

entries.name: Marrow Ward
entries.summary: You place a protective structural resonance around yourself or a willing creature, reducing the risk of fractures, crushing injury, and forced deformation. You may also reinforce an existing splint or harden shaped bone into protective material. The ward protects living structure but cannot be used to deform it or control its movement.

entries.name: Martyr Shield
entries.summary: Accept danger onto yourself to keep another person, oath, relic, or sacred duty from being broken. Redirects one severe consequence toward you if the sacrifice is credible.

entries.name: Mask Set
entries.summary: You settle into a role through posture, clothing, voice, and expectation. Use this to support a disguise, pass a brief inspection, or make a false identity feel believable.

entries.name: Maskbreak Insight
entries.summary: You catch the moment someone's mask slips and use it before they recover. Use this to reveal hidden fear, desire, guilt, divided loyalty, false confidence, or emotional leverage in a social scene.

entries.name: Masked Entrance
entries.summary: Arrive in a scene with identity, rumor, and appearance arranged for maximum impact. Shifts attention onto the persona rather than the person beneath it.

entries.name: Master Key
entries.summary: You reconstruct the logic of an exceptionally difficult human-made cipher from fragments, repeated traffic, and mistakes, producing a working key if enough evidence actually exists.

entries.name: Master Palate
entries.summary: You reconstruct much of a complex recipe, vintage, preparation method, or contamination history from a tiny safe sample, provided the relevant substances actually leave sensory evidence.

entries.name: Measure Feint
entries.summary: You open with a testing feint that makes the opponent reveal guard, temper, or preferred rhythm. Creates a clear read for the next exchange rather than simply improving an attack.

entries.name: Measured Endurance
entries.summary: You pace breath, movement, and intake to endure a harmful environment or substance without collapsing at once. Reduces the first worsening of fatigue, intoxication, or exposure.

entries.name: Measured Intervention
entries.summary: De-escalate a tense encounter while keeping tactical advantage through calm commands, positioning, and credible force. Reduces escalation while preserving tactical and social advantage.

entries.name: Mechanism Bypass
entries.summary: You identify a nonmagical machine critical dependency and create a controlled bypass, shutdown, or temporary substitute without rebuilding the whole system.

entries.name: Mechanism Unmade
entries.summary: Take apart a complex trap under pressure by reading the whole mechanism as one intent. Disarms or neutralizes a major mundane trap if physical access exists.

entries.name: Melt Away
entries.summary: Move to a concealed position or reduce your visible presence sharply without drawing attention. Most effective when you already have some cover.

entries.name: Memory Palace
entries.summary: You organize, clarify, and preserve a large body of memories in yourself or a willing target for one major scene, bringing fragmented recollection into usable order, separating damaged or false traces from clearer ones, or protecting an important experience from confusion. It cannot create memories that were never formed or force access against an unwilling person.

entries.name: Memory Stitch
entries.summary: You help a damaged, frightened, altered, or fragmented memory in yourself or a willing target reconnect enough to be understood. Use this to restore partial recollection, resist memory manipulation, preserve testimony, or establish a clear reminder without creating memories that were never formed.

entries.name: Memory Vault
entries.summary: You seal a coherent set of memories behind a deliberate mnemonic key in yourself or a willing target. The memories remain present but difficult to access without the key.

entries.name: Mend Fracture
entries.summary: You align and accelerate repair of broken bone, torn muscle, deep laceration, or damaged function. It can turn a crippling wound into a survivable injury, but it does not erase blood loss, exhaustion, or missing tissue.

entries.name: Mercy With Teeth
entries.summary: Protect a patient, penitent, dependent, refugee, or vulnerable witness by invoking duty, sanctuary, care, law, or moral authority. Protects a vulnerable person through duty, sanctuary, care, law, or moral authority.

entries.name: Metal Sense
entries.summary: You feel the weight, shape, stress, purity, temperature, and resonance of nearby metal. Use this to detect hidden metal, judge forged quality, sense weak points in armor or locks, identify alloys, or notice enchanted metalwork before touching it.

entries.name: Meteor Needle
entries.summary: You condense cold stellar force into one narrow descending or line-of-sight strike. It is precise enough to target a marked point rather than scattering a whole area.

entries.name: Meteor Volley Line
entries.summary: You turn ranged pressure into a controlled rain of shots that shapes enemy movement. Use this to pin a group, cover allies, punish a charge, or force enemies out of position.

entries.name: Minor Binding
entries.summary: You place a simple temporary enchantment on an object, doorway, tool, weapon, or warded spot. Use this to strengthen, lock, resist picking, hold an edge, preserve a function, or make an object answer one clear instruction.

entries.name: Minor Illusion
entries.summary: You create a simple visual, sound, scent, or brief sensory falsehood at short range. Use this to distract, hide a small action, mislead a casual observer, or create an image that fails under close inspection or touch.

entries.name: Minor Summon
entries.summary: You call a small elemental construct, spirit-servant, familiar echo, or bound force for one brief purpose. Use this to scout, carry, distract, fetch, guard, or perform a simple task.

entries.name: Miracle of Practice
entries.summary: Bring every lesson, failure, and instinct to bear on a patient everyone else thinks lost. Can preserve life through an extreme mundane medical crisis if any plausible chance remains.

entries.name: Mirror Army
entries.summary: You create many moving false copies of one or several people across a scene. The doubles confuse targeting and formation reads but cannot independently cause real physical effects.

entries.name: Mirror Exchange
entries.summary: You swap the apparent position of yourself and one prepared reflection or mirror-double for a brief moment. It creates a sudden positional deception rather than true long-range teleportation.

entries.name: Mirror Image
entries.summary: You create a speaking, moving reflection-double through a mirror, water surface, polished metal, or other reflective plane. The image has no true body and breaks under touch, disruption, or careful inspection.

entries.name: Mirror Self
entries.summary: You step through one prepared or attuned reflective surface and emerge from another. Both surfaces must be known, stable, and large enough to matter, and mirror wards can trap or distort the passage.

entries.name: Mirror Window
entries.summary: You turn a reflective surface into a viewing window connected to another known, seen, or attuned reflection. Wards, darkness, broken surfaces, and unfamiliar mirrors limit the view.

entries.name: Mirror-Glass Screen
entries.summary: You spread glass into angled transparent plates that distort sight and catch attacks from several directions. Strong impacts can shatter the screen into hazardous fragments.

entries.name: Misfortune Thread
entries.summary: You attach a fragile unlucky pattern to one target so small errors, bad footing, mistimed choices, or weak equipment are more likely to matter. Strong preparation and Fate resistance can break the thread.

entries.name: Mist Mantle
entries.summary: You turn nearby water into a moving defensive haze around a group, softening heat, obscuring aim, and feeding controlled currents. It is broad protection rather than a precise attack.

entries.name: Mnemonic Archive
entries.summary: You organize a vast body of memories into an accessible internal archive, allowing rapid cross-reference of experiences, names, places, and details. False or corrupted memories remain false rather than becoming truth.

entries.name: Mnemonic Glimpse
entries.summary: You touch a recent memory trace in yourself, a willing target, or an attuned object and bring one blurred detail into sharper focus. It cannot create a memory that was never formed.

entries.name: Moment of History
entries.summary: You turn a major public performance, declaration, rite, or appearance into a shared moment that thousands can understand and remember, coordinating message, timing, symbolism, and audience response. It can define how an event is perceived without controlling every witness.

entries.name: Momentum Catch
entries.summary: You seize a small amount of existing motion and redirect or bleed it away. Use this to soften a fall, spoil a thrown object, steady a stumble, or help a moving object turn.

entries.name: Momentum Step
entries.summary: You gather movement into a sudden controlled burst, turning a step, dodge, leap, swing, or fall into sharper motion. Use this to cross distance, evade danger, redirect a charge, add force to a strike, or keep moving through difficult terrain.

entries.name: Momentum Turn
entries.summary: You redirect momentum from a fall, throw, or impact into a landing, swing, or counter-move. Lets you survive dangerous movement and keep acting instead of ending prone.

entries.name: Moonfall Counter
entries.summary: You wait until the enemy's strongest motion commits, then answer with a crushing reversal. Use this after surviving, dodging, blocking, or reading a major attack to turn the enemy's force against them.

entries.name: Moonlit Veil
entries.summary: You call silver moonlight, night-shadow, tidal instinct, or hidden reflection around a person or place. Use this to reveal concealed emotion, hide movement in darkness, calm beasts, mark a shapeshifter, or sense what changes under night.

entries.name: Moonstep
entries.summary: You move through dim moonlit space with uncanny grace, crossing a short visible route while becoming difficult to track or intercept. It is swift movement, not teleportation.

entries.name: Moonwake
entries.summary: You fill the scene with mythic moon pressure: silver revelation, transformation, tide-pull, night instinct, and hidden truths rising. The effect is strongest under night, moonlight, dreams, or emotional tides.

entries.name: Motif Recall
entries.summary: You recognize a melody, rhythm, instrument tradition, or recurring motif and recall where it is commonly used or what social context it belongs to.

entries.name: Motion Catch
entries.summary: You follow fast movement through clutter and keep track of the true body, hand, projectile, or opening when ordinary observers would lose it.

entries.name: Motion Nudge
entries.summary: You alter a small movement already in progress, slightly speeding, slowing, tilting, or redirecting it. Use this to improve balance, make a thrown object drift, spoil an enemy aim, soften a stumble, or add snap to a quick action.

entries.name: Mountain Skin
entries.summary: You harden body and stance with Titan endurance across a demanding scene, reducing the effect of crushing force, heavy impacts, and impossible weight while still allowing injury.

entries.name: Mountain Stance
entries.summary: You become almost impossible to move, knock down, frighten, or force aside. Use this to hold a doorway, stop a charge, brace a collapsing structure, shield allies, or endure a blow that should break your footing.

entries.name: Mountain-Mover
entries.summary: You turn strength, leverage, and impossible timing into a force that changes terrain and bodies alike. Use this to hurl massive enemies, break barriers, stop monstrous charges, move impossible weight, or weaponize the environment.

entries.name: Mounted Guard
entries.summary: Use mount movement, shield angle, and body position to protect a nearby ally while riding. Redirects pressure away from a vulnerable target during mounted movement.

entries.name: Mythic Claim
entries.summary: Understand the story, authority, and symbolic demand a legendary relic places on its bearer. Allows a worthy interaction with the relic without being immediately overwhelmed by its legacy.
